Reservation is provided for:
• Scheduled Castes (SC)
• Scheduled Tribes (ST)
• Women – minimum one-third of total seats

Many states provide 50% reservation for women.

rows: 50% of total seats in many states

items: Competitive exams often test the minimum baseline reservation for women, which is 1/3rd of total seats.
Be aware that SC and ST reservations are mandatory, alongside women's reservation.
Distinguish between the constitutional minimum (1/3rd) and state-specific higher provisions (50%).

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Reservation in Panchayats is guaranteed for Scheduled Castes (SC) and Scheduled Tribes (ST).
A mandatory minimum of one-third (1/3) of total seats is reserved for women.
Multiple states have expanded women's representation by offering up to 50% reservation.
